Georgia Home Repair and Maintenance

You're looking for a reliable contractor to handle your home repair and maintenance needs in Georgia, and you want to know what to expect from the process. On this site, you can find information on the services offered by Build Heritage, a licensed and insured Georgia home-services contractor, and get a free, written, and itemized quote for your project.

How it Works for Homeowners

Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, covering areas such as Atlanta, Marietta, and Alpharetta. They offer 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing. You can contact them through the quote form or by emailing info@buildheritage.org. They will respond with a quote within one business day. Their services are designed to help you maintain and repair your home, whether you need a whole-home interior repaint or a full roof replacement.

What You Get and What it Costs

The cost of home repair and maintenance services varies depending on the project. According to the 2026 cost guide, updated in August 2026, a full roof replacement can cost between $9,000-$20,000, and a whole-home interior repaint can cost between $3,000-$8,000. It's recommended to hold back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? Build Heritage serves metro Atlanta and Georgia, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. How do I get a quote? You can get a free, written, and itemized quote by contacting Build Heritage through the quote form or by emailing info@buildheritage.org. What trades do you offer? Build Heritage offers 8 trades, including packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, and roofing & tiles.

Get your free quote today
